# telnyx_verify_profiles (Data Source)

Lists verify profiles, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_verify_profile`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) Optional filter for profile names.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `verify_profiles` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verify_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--verify_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verify_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `call` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verify_profiles--call))
- `created_at` (String)
- `daily_spend_limit` (Number) The maximum daily spend allowed on this verify profile, in USD.
- `daily_spend_limit_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the daily spend limit is enforced for this verify profile.
- `flashcall` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verify_profiles--flashcall))
- `id` (String)
- `language` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String) The possible verification profile record types.
- `sms` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verify_profiles--sms))
- `updated_at` (String)
- `webhook_failover_url` (String)
- `webhook_url` (String)
- `whatsapp` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verify_profiles--whatsapp))

<a id="nestedatt--verify_profiles--call"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verify_profiles.call`

Read-Only:

- `app_name` (String) The name that identifies the application requesting 2fa in the verification message.
- `code_length` (Number) The length of the verify code to generate.
- `default_verification_timeout_secs` (Number) For every request that is initiated via this Verify profile, this sets the number of seconds before a verification request code expires. Once the verification request expires, the user cannot use the code to verify their identity.
- `messaging_template_id` (String) The message template identifier selected from /verify_profiles/templates
- `whitelisted_destinations` (Set of String) Enabled country destinations to send verification codes. The elements in the list must be valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. If set to `["*"]`, all destinations will be allowed. **Conditionally required:** this field must be provided when your organization is configured to require explicit whitelisted destinations; otherwise it is optional.
